intel_summary.summary: US stocks surged on Monday Nov 23 after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO (S&P 500 +4.73%, Nasdaq Composite +6.51%), then partly reversed on Tuesday: S&P 500 -0.50%, Nasdaq -1.48%, while the Dow closed above 50,000 for the first time on a rotation into value stocks. Nvidia fell 5.86% to $155.38 on Tuesday. Crypto stayed weak: Bitcoin was near $60k and Ether near $1,700, with spot Ether ETF outflows continuing. Brent was about $89 ahead of the Nov 29 OPEC+ meeting, and gold rebounded from 14-month lows. US PCE inflation data is due Wednesday Nov 25 while markets price Fed hike risk.
